messages:
ellie-privacy: FYI - ACME (tenant: acme-eu) escalated a DPA erasure problem. They ran our export and found PII left in a debug bundle. When they retried the erase API they got a 403. They want deletion proof + timeline. Escalating now.

samir-support: Ack. Can you paste the customer request id and the export path?

ellie-privacy: RequestID: req_20260307_8921. Export path: gs://redwood-exports/acme-eu/debug/2026-03-07/msgs.ndjson.gz (customer points to ~line 42 with 3 email rows). They also attached a screenshot of a 403 from our erase API.

toni-sre: :eyes: I'll pull audit logs and object metadata. Quick question — is acme-eu on Dedicated using a customer-managed KMS key? @kai-eng

kai-eng: Yes, acme-eu is Dedicated with a CMK: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111:key/abcd. We rotated grants on that key on 2026-03-06. Possible missing decrypt grant for the backup job role.

samir-support: Also FYI customer saw a sudden token billing spike after they retried deletions repeatedly — could be duplicate operations causing extra generation. They provided billing screenshots.

toni-sre: Repro steps I'm going to run (please paste outputs if you run locally):
1) Audit events: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN" "https://internal-api.redwood.ai/audit/events?request=req_20260307_8921"`
2) Object ACL: `gsutil acl get gs://redwood-exports/acme-eu/debug/2026-03-07/msgs.ndjson.gz`
3) Backup job logs: `kubectl -n backups logs deploy/backup-worker --since=48h | grep acme-eu`

Please run and paste relevant snippets.

ellie-privacy: Running step 1 now. Customer log excerpt also showed: `error: 403 Forbidden - kms:Decrypt denied for key abcd` in the export job logs.

kai-eng: That aligns. If the backup process couldn't decrypt snapshots after the grant change, it might have left partial files with unredacted data. The delete API may return 403 if erase worker can't access the CMK to mark/overwrite key-protected objects. We need to confirm KMS denies are root cause.

samir-support: Can we proactively produce deletion proof for the customer (audit rows + object metadata) without exposing other tenants? They asked for signed proof and a timeline.

toni-sre: I'll pull CloudTrail entries for the CMK: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111:key/abcd --start-time 2026-03-05 --end-time 2026-03-08` and redact to acme-eu. I'll share a filtered extract.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1423 - "Dedicated CMK deny causing partial erasure for acme-eu" assigned to eng-oncall.

ellie-privacy: Two asks for output: 1) A safe, redacted deletion proof (audit + bucket metadata) that we can hand to the customer without exposing other tenants. 2) Short-term mitigation to stop billing spike / duplicate token churn while we fix the root cause.

kai-eng: For (1) we can generate a signed, redacted audit export filtered to acme-eu and produce an attestation doc signed with our internal signing key (and reference the CloudTrail KMS entries). For (2) we should throttle retries on the delete endpoint and add an idempotency key to the erase workflow to prevent repeated token generation. I'll open a PR tomorrow morning.

samir-support: I'll tell the customer to pause automated retry loops and to share the workspace ID + exact timestamps. I'll also request they upload the export bundle so we can inspect.

toni-sre: Update from CloudTrail: found a Deny for `kms:Decrypt` from `backup-role@acme` at 2026-03-06T02:13:54Z — matches the grant rotation window. That likely caused the backup job to fail to decrypt and left partial exported files.

ellie-privacy: Great. Please add an ETA for the customer update.

kai-eng: ETA: SRE to confirm and attach CloudTrail extract within 6 hours. Eng to draft attestation + open idempotency/throttle PR within 24-36 hours.

samir-support: Noted — I set customer expectation: evidence + timeline in 6-8 hours, mitigation in 24-48 hours. I'll keep legal in the loop for wording.

support-bot: INC-2026-1423 updated: tags [dpa, kms, dedicated, billing].

ellie-privacy: Thanks team :pray: Drop artifacts here when ready (CloudTrail extract, redacted audit export, and the attestation doc).
